title: Model-Version-Aware Adaptive DA-LinTS State Management
research_question: When an explicitly observed classifier/model version changes, does version-indexed DA-LinTS state isolation improve Phase-B adaptive-defense performance relative to full Phase-B reset?

motivation.continuous_state_result: Three matched seeds were worse than full reset on Phase-B reward and post-defense risk for all seeds; no significance claim was made.
motivation.partial_reset_result: The pre-registered fixed 50% partial reset did not justify replacing full reset.
motivation.implementation_inspection: The active learned posterior is represented only by per-arm B and f sufficient statistics. Posterior caches are derived. Serialized auxiliary state includes RNG, CUSUM, aggregates, and timestamps.
motivation.design_implication: There is no pre-existing robust_alone state before this one-way transition; transferring or shrinking standard state would be ungrounded.

hypotheses.primary: Version-indexed state isolation has a positive paired Phase-B mean-reward difference versus full reset and satisfies all safety and integrity gates.
hypotheses.null_negative: The intervention fails one or more advancement gates. An exact tie is an expected valid negative result for a first exposure to robust_alone because its active state starts at the same prior as full reset.
hypotheses.significance_statement: No statistical-significance claim will be made solely from these 10 seeds.

baseline.name: full_phase_b_reset
baseline.boundary_action: Replace the Phase-A local learner with a fresh unchanged DA-LinTS learner immediately before Phase B.
baseline.initial_posterior: For every arm, B=lambda*I and f=0.

intervention.name: version_indexed_learner_state_isolation
intervention.description: Freeze the complete standard learner state in an experiment-local registry and activate the robust_alone partition. A missing version partition is initialized at the ordinary prior; inactive state is never merged, sampled, updated, or discounted.
intervention.scientific_rationale: It invalidates all model-dependent posterior information instead of selecting another arbitrary shrinkage percentage, while preserving version provenance for a future separately preregistered recurrence design.
intervention.first_transition_consequence: robust_alone has no stored state, so its active Phase-B posterior is exactly the full-reset prior when random streams are coupled.

state_definition.derived_cache_policy: Caches are regenerated from B and f and never transferred independently.

boundary.timing: After Phase-A episode 100 and before Phase-B episode 101.
boundary.prohibited_transfer: No standard-state value may enter active Phase-B B, f, posterior cache, CUSUM, RNG, or diagnostics.

protocol.manifest_protocol: One fixed 200-episode manifest per seed, created before either policy runs and shared by policies. Image indices, attacks, epsilons, torch randomness, and Phase-B sampling stream are matched per seed.

metrics.reporting_rule: Report episode-level and per-seed data; do not rely solely on aggregate means. Lower-is-better differences state their direction explicitly.

conditions: No implementation-integrity or pathological-detector failure occurs.
advancement_rule.failure_rule: If any condition fails, full Phase-B reset remains the baseline and the outcome is a valid negative result.
advancement_rule.integrity_gate: Matched manifests/checkpoints/config; 100 active Phase-B updates per policy per seed; prior-only active robust B/f at boundary; unchanged detector/discount path; validated artifacts.

cusum.role: secondary diagnostic only; not a model-version detector or primary signal
cusum.interpretation: Alarms are not required and no claim may state that CUSUM detected the version change.

reproducibility_and_artifacts: all raw logs and unfavorable artifacts
expected_contribution: Separates known version boundaries from residual-drift detection and tests a provenance-safe state lifecycle without inventing posterior transfer. A tie establishes that partitioning is not evidence of transfer benefit on a first one-way transition; reuse on recurrence requires a separate preregistered study.
